What the manual must show, and what Filestage holds

The thirteen sections are the brief's own list (Manual content, v3). A section marked text only needs no artwork. A section marked missing needs an example and has none in the review — that is the gap that matters, because nothing can be approved that nobody has seen.

Three colours were wrong in the artwork edition

The artwork edition of this manual was built on the hex codes printed inside the old 155-page PDF. The brief names those three codes as defects and gives the approved set. They are corrected here, and the edition has to be rebuilt on them.

Neon accents — approved values

The brief's own audit: “Accent HEX codes on the swatches don't match the approved colours: #A766E6, #C9F034, #FF3255 — replace with #A259FF, #C6FF35, #FF2D55 everywhere, including swatches and any neon artwork.” CMYK is a straight conversion and will print duller; match each neon against a physical Pantone guide with the printer before the first run.
